The '''TIE bomber combat medallion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] medal awarded for completing basic training with [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]. It had an engraving of a TIE/sa bomber.

There were three versions of the medal, which differed only in the metal used to create it: [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]], and [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. The bronze version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the TIE/sa's armament of proton torpedoes as well as space bombs. The silver version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the above as well as a reenactment of an operation dealing with taking out a Rebel outpost with torpedoes. The gold version was presented to pilots who completed the above training operations as well as training regarding the TIE/sa's onboard missile complement.

==Known recipients==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] received all three versions of this medal after completing the training ops relating to the TIE/sa when he was freshly recruited.
